description: This file defines a PHP class for rendering a Google Map interface for editing map markers within the SuiteCRM module 'jjwg_Markers'. It includes methods for displaying the map, handling geocoding, and updating marker positions, with embedded HTML and JavaScript for the map UI.

classes.name: Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Edit_Map
classes.description: A view class extending SugarView to render and manage a Google Map for marker editing within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the map interface, initializes Google Maps, handles geocoding, marker dragging, and updates form fields with marker position and address.
